svg.title: 04b-initial-self-energy
svg.desc: Real56-atom silicon input positions and periodic cells1through7. Example local support comprises cells3through5, colored teal,blue and orange. The same cell labels identify local self-energy blocks, selected device rows of Es, and the embedded contribution in device rows and columns3through5. Each displayed matrix entry is a24-coordinate cell block, not one atom. Es has identity blocks at(3,1),(4,2),(5,3); other selector blocks and the unfilled embedded blocks are zero. Independent local blocksa throughi do not assume Hermiticity. This cell-aligned example illustrates mapping only; actual interaction supports include every retained endpoint and need not equal these three cells.

g.aria-label: 56 silicon input positions, 3.80 nanometre device, 1.63 nanometre example local support
g.title: Silicon calculation input: 7 conventional cells
g.desc: Exact input fractional positions projected orthographically; a=5.43356003 angstrom, [100] transport. Transverse directions are periodic. Dashed layer boundaries mark the conventional-cell repeat. Atom positions are not jittered. Lengths span cell boundaries.
